description: A flat, pointed-toe slingback flat featuring a woven straw-like material with a braided texture and a low-profile, flat heel. The design includes a slingback strap for secure fit and a minimalist, slip-on construction. The natural tan color and woven construction evoke a summery, bohemian aesthetic.

A pair of flat, woven straw sandals featuring thin, braided straps that cross over the instep and wrap around the ankle. The upper is constructed from a textured, light beige woven material with a subtle diamond-stitched pattern, accented by small metallic triangular logos at the toe. The sole is a smooth, tan-colored flat heel.

A minimalist black suede slingback flat shoe featuring a square toe and a low block heel. The design includes a thin strap with a gold-toned buckle closure across the heel. The silhouette is clean and classic, with a flat sole for comfort.

A sleek, black leather slingback flat shoe featuring a pointed toe and a decorative pleated front panel. Constructed with a low, block heel and a slender slingback strap for secure fit, the silhouette is minimalist and elegant. The pebbled leather texture adds subtle dimension to the otherwise clean-lined design.

A navy blue suede slingback flat featuring a pointed toe and a low, block heel. The shoe is constructed with a slingback strap secured by a silver-toned buckle, and the interior lining is tan leather. The suede material provides a soft, matte texture, and the silhouette is classic and elegant.

A minimalist pair of beige slingback flats featuring a pointed toe and a thin, flat heel. Constructed from smooth leather with a slip-on silhouette, the design is accented by a thin ankle strap with a gold-tone buckle closure. The clean lines and neutral color make it a versatile, elegant choice for smart-casual or office wear.

A women's flat sandal featuring a woven brown upper with a square toe and a low block heel. The design includes a thin ankle strap with a gold-tone buckle and a contrasting tan insole. The construction highlights a textured, artisanal woven pattern across the vamp and a layered wooden heel detail.

A coral-colored leather loafer-style flat shoe with a pointed toe and decorative white stitching along the vamp. Features a slingback strap with a gold-toned buckle closure and a low-profile, flat heel. The construction includes a slip-on silhouette with a padded collar for comfort.

A minimalist, pale yellow leather slingback flat shoe featuring a rounded toe and a distinctive gathered, elasticated strap at the heel. The silhouette is sleek and modern with a flat, slightly textured sole. The construction highlights clean stitching and a slip-on design for ease of wear.

A two-tone slingback flat featuring a cream body and brown cap toe, accented with a decorative bow and gold-tone logo detail at the vamp. Constructed with a low block heel and a buckle-fastened slingback strap for secure fit. The silhouette is classic and refined, with clean lines and a minimalist aesthetic.

A chic, two-tone leather slingback flat featuring a black upper with a contrasting brown toe cap, accented by a decorative black bow and a gold-tone logo plaque. The design includes a thin ankle strap with a buckle closure and a low, block heel for comfortable wear. The silhouette is classic and elegant, with a rounded toe and clean, minimalist lines.

A minimalist, almond-toe slingback pump in a soft ivory hue, crafted from smooth leather with a delicate kitten heel and a slender ankle strap with a silver-toned buckle. The design is accented by a subtle, sculpted logo element at the toe, adding a refined brand detail without overwhelming the clean silhouette.
